messages:
maria_support: heads up — Acme reported an API key found in a public gist. They're seeing usage spikes and some 403/429 errors. Customer wants immediate rotation, audit of requests, confirmation on data retention, and proof of rotation. IPs: 52.14.22.10, 18.204.11.5. Suspected UA: curl/7.79.1. Can sec/sre take containment?

sam_security: ack. Priorities: 1) rotate and revoke old key server-side, 2) snapshot audit logs + KMS/HSM access logs, 3) verify no HSM compromise, 4) produce signed rotation proof. Please provide key_id.

lee_sre: For immediate mitigation I can add an edge IP block and throttle the key. Will also isolate tenant to avoid noisy neighbor latency. Applying ACL now — will report rule id.

maria_support: key_id is 4f3c2b. Customer says they rotated client-side but want us to rotate server-side and confirm old key is invalid. They also reported +$2,300 in unexpected usage in last 6 hours.

deploy-bot: action: ip-block applied -> rule rb-904, targets frontends prod-01..prod-04.

sam_security: commands for ops to pull audit trail: `SELECT * FROM audit.events WHERE key_id='4f3c2b' AND ts >= '2026-03-15T20:00:00Z' ORDER BY ts;` Check endpoints called (`/v1/embeddings`, `/v1/generate`). Also check KMS decrypt logs: CloudKMS shows decrypts at 2026-03-16T01:22Z from svc-ingest@redwood-prod.

lee_sre: I see a spike starting 2026-03-16T00:48Z — high parallel token gen. Rate limiter breached and cache evicted, caused fallback to slower path and latency blips for a few other tenants. We throttled key and pinned that tenant to a lower-Q model to protect capacity.

maria_support: customer asking about retention policy and DSR — do we keep full request payloads 90 days? compliance, please advise if we can purge inputs on request.

emma_support: tagging privacy/compliance + legal. Our hosted default retention for full request logs is 30 days unless extended by enterprise contract. Dedicated/Private tenants manage retention themselves. I'll open a compliance ticket to evaluate targeted deletion for key_id=4f3c2b after forensics snapshot.

sam_security: forensics plan: 1) take immutable snapshot of audit logs and KMS/HSM access logs to secure bucket (no external access), 2) analyze for PII and exfil patterns, 3) gather rotation_event_id and HMAC-signed nonce for customer proof, 4) after approval, perform targeted purge of non-essential logs. HSM keys were not exported — no sign of export.

lee_sre: repro steps for internal ops team: 1) `curl -s "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/audit?key=4f3c2b&since=2026-03-15" > /secure/forensic/4f3c2b/events.json` 2) export to secure-bucket `gs://redwood-forensics/4f3c2b/` 3) rotate key via API: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/4f3c2b/rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'` 4) apply ip block & rate-limit 5) run billing lookup `./scripts/billing-lookup --key 4f3c2b --since 2026-03-15`

maria_support: customer wants rotation proof. Sam — can you provide rotation_event_id and a signed HMAC for verification? Also which models were used with the key?

sam_security: rotation returned `evt_9b1f`. I'll produce a signed proof (HMAC-SHA256) with the rotation_event_id and timestamp, and include a sanitized list of models: ["gpt-neo-32", "rw-infer-v1"]. Will redact all user inputs from the report.

emma_support: customer also asked whether we enforce KMS-wrapped API keys for hosted users. Short answer: not required today, but we recommend storing secrets in customer KMS and using short-lived tokens / OAuth ephemeral tokens. I'll draft recommended guidance and a checklist for them.

maria_support: notes for follow-up: sam — finalize forensics & signed proof; lee — confirm billing adjustments for the spike and confirm latency mitigation stayed within SLA targets; emma — send customer guidance and open compliance ticket for deletion after approval. I will update customer by EOD with mitigation timeline and provide the signed rotation proof. :white_check_mark:
